name: _hud.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field/_hud.scss — the HUD cluster: keyboard hint, aria-live
//  announcements, and the hover tooltip (leader line + `{name} · {dist}`
//  label) pinned to the picked body's projected screen position.
//  Imported by star-field.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_SF}-hud {
  position: absolute;
  // Clears the fixed nav chrome, a pad below its row.
  top: calc(#{$_NAV_INSET} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  z-index: 20;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
  pointer-events: none;
  text-align: center;
}

.#{$_B_SF}-hint {
  @extend .txt-sm;

  // Paints straight on deep space — sky ink never themes with the chrome.
  color: var(--sf-sky-ink);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.#{$_B_SF}-live {
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  color: var(--sf-sky-ink-2);
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  min-height: to-rem($space-lg);
}

// Scale disclaimer — the honesty strip pinned to the bottom edge between
// the nav toggle and action cluster. One row, muted, non-interactive.
.#{$_B_SF}-disclaimer {
  @extend .txt-sm;

  position: absolute;
  // Sits one pad above the framed viewport's lower edge — the same line
  // the nav toggle and action buttons hang from.
  bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-xl)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  left: 50%;
  translate: -50% 0;
  z-index: 20;
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 72vw;
  pointer-events: none;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--sf-sky-ink);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

// The root is a zero-size anchor translated by JS onto the body's projected
// screen position; the line is a constant-geometry rotated hairline so no
// JS angle math is needed — only the root translate runs per frame.
.#{$_B_SF}-tip {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  z-index: 25;
  pointer-events: none;

  // The picked-body marker dot.
  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-sm);
    height: to-rem($space-sm);
    left: -(to-rem($space-sm) / 2);
    top: -(to-rem($space-sm) / 2);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-sky-ink-2);
    background: var(--sf-sky-faint);
  }

  &-line {
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-3xl);
    height: var(--space-hairline);
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    transform-origin: 0 0;
    transform: rotate(-50deg);
    background: var(--sf-sky-ink);
  }

  &-label {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    font-weight: 500;
    position: absolute;
    left: to-rem($space-2xl);
    bottom: to-rem($space-2xl + $space-sm);
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    background: var(--sf-chrome);
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
  }

  // Edge-hint mode — the object sits off-screen or behind the camera:
  // the marker is clamped to the canvas rim and the leader line rotates
  // via --sf-tip-angle to point toward it, so navigator-hover hints
  // locate the body at any zoom level. The label flips inward on the
  // two axes so it never clips off-canvas.
  &--edge &-line {
    transform: rotate(var(--sf-tip-angle));
  }

  &--flipx &-label {
    left: auto;
    right: to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  &--flipy &-label {
    bottom: auto;
    top: to-rem($space-2xl + $space-sm);
  }
}
